findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 14 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Biology Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 15 questions numbered 1-15; by section: 14.1 1, 14.1.1 1, 14.1.2 1, 14.1.3 4, 14.2 3, 14.3.1 1, 14.3.2 1, 14.3.3 2, 14.3.4 1.

Covers the roles of the urinary system and position of its organs, the renal corpuscle and the two types of nephrons, the blood supply of the kidney, glomerular filtration (cause of pressure, filtrate composition), reabsorption along each part of the tubule, tubular secretion with the path of urine, factors affecting urine volume, the two limbs of the loop of Henle and the salty medulla, ADH in dehydration and excess water, aldosterone compared with ADH, UTIs, the two lithotripsy methods, acute and chronic failure with the need for dialysis, peritoneal dialysis steps, and kidney donors. The exercise's long questions are not repeated (different angle). Book corrections followed: cystine stones; thirst created by the hypothalamus. Avoided: PCT 'dipping into the medulla', the renal capsule around the adrenal gland, secretion limited to the distal tubule.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
